preconditions.description: The length of the string n and the maximum number of changes k are within the specified bounds.
The string s consists of letters 'a' and 'b' only.

postconditions.description: The maximum beauty of the string is a valid length between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: max_length == max(len(list(group)) for _, group in itertools.groupby(s))
postconditions.description: The maximum beauty of the string is the length of the longest substring of consecutive equal letters after making at most k changes.
